scope_notes: Publicly discoverable domain datasets; public in this catalog does not mean public domain, unrestricted, acquired, qualified, or eligible for training/final assessment.

Immutable upstream revisions and selected file metadata were resolved from official HTTP metadata, Git refs, repository documentation/tree listings and HTTP HEAD. No dataset payload was downloaded or executed to author this catalog.

Files are an explicit selected text/tabular acquisition mapping, not an exhaustive upstream repository inventory. Scripts, notebooks, weights, images, linked PDFs and redundant representations are excluded as documented per source.
Native configurations/splits preserve source organization only. Non-HF configuration names denote native subsets; empty arrays mean not established/not applicable. No local PartitionRole is assigned.

Publisher sizes count different units and may describe larger releases than selected files. Label provenance and group hints require adapter review; never infer human gold from machine scores or prompt references.
Acquisition mapped means selected bytes are addressable, not a license clearance or runtime qualification. Gated/restricted/unclear candidates remain present with explicit blockers.

File expected_sha256 is supplied only when official HF LFS metadata exposes a valid SHA256. Null means content hash must be computed and retained on acquisition; HTTP ETags are not treated as cryptographic content hashes.
Keep public exposure, original corpus provenance, license notices, nullable labels, rater disagreement and original row identifiers through every downstream flow.
